changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingdebitaccount AS SELECT bda.id, bda.account_number, bda.patient_id, bda.currency, bda.credit_limit, bda.current_debit_balance, bda.available_credit, bda.total_debit_created, bda.total_debit_settled, bda.status, bda.debit_allowed, bda.approval_required, bda.approved_by, bda.approved_date, bda.blocked_by, bda.blocked_date, bda.block_reason, bda.expiry_date, bda.notes, bda.created_by, bda.created_date, bda.last_modified_by, bda.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_debit_account bda;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingdebitaccount TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingdebitaccount FROM report_user;
